text.title: 装不下的文件
text.situation:
档案屏让游客比较旧纸照片和数字版本；说明以 digitalized 表示转换成数字形式。乔想把影像发到智能手机，但演示文件太大。讲解员展示软件如何压缩文件。界面有清晰的默认设置和简短菜单，玛雅觉得易用。屏幕后，过时设备附有日期和曾经用途。新菜单更容易理解，不过讲解员没有承诺所有压缩文件都能保持相同质量。

乔：压缩会去掉部分画面吗？
讲解员：取决于方法和设置，这里只是展示例子。
玛雅：可以恢复默认设置吗？
讲解员：可以，那个按钮让菜单恢复初始设置。

paragraphs.en: At the archive screen, visitors could compare an old paper photograph with its digitized version. A note used digitalized for the conversion into digital form. Jo wanted to send the image to her smartphone, but the demonstration file was too large. The guide showed how software could compress it. The interface had a clear default setting and a short menu, which Maya found user-friendly. Behind the screen, an obsolete device was displayed with its date and former purpose. The new menu was easier to understand, although the guide did not promise that every compressed file would keep the same quality.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Will compressing the file remove part of the picture?
Guide: It depends on the method and settings. This is only the display example.
Maya: Can we restore the default?
Guide: Yes. That button returns this menu to its initial setting.
